**May 15, 2025**

Dr. Ryan McDonald

Today, I saw Christina Leblanc for a follow-up regarding her Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). She presented with her usual stable condition. During this visit, I noted her blood pressure to be 126/83, and her weight was 145 pounds. Christina reports that she is feeling quite well overall and has been adhering to her treatment regimen. She continues to take roflumilast 500 mcg daily and fluticasone-umeclidinium-vilanterol 100/62.5/25. Her FEV1 is stable at 95% predicted, which is quite commendable considering her diagnosis. There are no new symptoms or concerns at this time.
